name: Oakland International Airport

runway.v: four runways (15/33, 12/30, 10R/28L, 10L/28R); the longest size shown on the FAA diagram is 10,520 ft x 150 ft (about 3,206 m x 46 m)

customs.v: CBP arrival inspections generally 7 days a week, 08:30-15:30; CBP office weekdays 06:00-18:00 and weekends 08:00-16:00 Pacific Time; permission to land must be requested at least 24 hours before arrival; outside these hours contact Westbay Cargo

ppr.v: for international arrivals, CBP permission to land at least 24 hours in advance
ppr.quote: at least 24 hours in advance of the anticipated arrival time

notes: Runway designators and sizes are from the FAA airport diagram AL-294 (6 Aug-3 Sep 2026); the extracted text lists 6213 X 150, 10520 X 150 and 5457 X 150 without tying each to a runway, so only the longest size is recorded; metres are my conversion (1 ft = 0.3048 m). No Port of Oakland noise or night-rules page was found and read, so curfew is not recorded (do not show 'no curfew'). FAA Chart Supplement SW (3 Sep 2026, https://aeronav.faa.gov/Upload_313-d/supplements/CS_SW_20260903.pdf) could not be opened. A CBP KOAK sheet dated 3 Dec 2024 (https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2024-12/KOAK%20GA%20Airport%20Fact%20Sheet%2020241203.pdf) could not be opened; the 20 Nov 2024 sheet was used.
